questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very bright or shining?
explanation: Luminous is correct - L-U-M-I-N-O-U-S. Luminous means emitting or reflecting bright light.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning extremely loud?
explanation: Deafening is correct - D-E-A-F-E-N-I-N-G. Deafening means extremely loud.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to move swiftly?
explanation: Accelerate is correct - A-C-C-E-L-E-R-A-T-E. To accelerate means to begin to move more quickly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very tiny?
explanation: Minuscule is correct - M-I-N-U-S-C-U-L-E. Minuscule means extremely small or tiny.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to make clearer?
explanation: Clarify is correct - C-L-A-R-I-F-Y. To clarify means to make a statement or situation less confused.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning having great depth?
explanation: Profound is correct - P-R-O-F-O-U-N-D. Profound means very great or intense, having intellectual depth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to strengthen?
explanation: Reinforce is correct - R-E-I-N-F-O-R-C-E. To reinforce means to strengthen or support something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very bright in color?
explanation: Vivid is correct - V-I-V-I-D. Vivid means intensely deep or bright in color or detail.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to judge or estimate?
explanation: Evaluate is correct - E-V-A-L-U-A-T-E. To evaluate means to form an idea of the amount or value of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning lasting forever?
explanation: Perpetual is correct - P-E-R-P-E-T-U-A-L. Perpetual means never ending or changing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to express an idea?
explanation: Articulate is correct - A-R-T-I-C-U-L-A-T-E. To articulate means to express an idea clearly and coherently.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning filled with fear?
explanation: Petrified is correct - P-E-T-R-I-F-I-E-D. Petrified means so frightened that one is unable to move.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to pretend?
explanation: Simulate is correct - S-I-M-U-L-A-T-E. To simulate means to imitate or pretend something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning relating to touch?
explanation: Tactile is correct - T-A-C-T-I-L-E. Tactile means relating to the sense of touch.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to reduce in size?
explanation: Diminish is correct - D-I-M-I-N-I-S-H. To diminish means to make or become less.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very serious?
explanation: Solemn is correct - S-O-L-E-M-N. Solemn means formal and dignified, or very serious.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to scatter in different directions?
explanation: Disperse is correct - D-I-S-P-E-R-S-E. To disperse means to go or spread in different directions.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning extremely complex?
explanation: Intricate is correct - I-N-T-R-I-C-A-T-E. Intricate means very complicated or detailed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to breathe out?
explanation: Exhale is correct - E-X-H-A-L-E. To exhale means to breathe out air from the lungs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning happening by chance?
explanation: Spontaneous is correct - S-P-O-N-T-A-N-E-O-U-S. Spontaneous means happening or arising without apparent cause.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to go across?
explanation: Traverse is correct - T-R-A-V-E-R-S-E. To traverse means to travel across or through.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very different from what is expected?
explanation: Paradoxical is correct - P-A-R-A-D-O-X-I-C-A-L. Paradoxical means seemingly contradictory but possibly true.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to give a name?
explanation: Designate is correct - D-E-S-I-G-N-A-T-E. To designate means to officially appoint or label something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning able to bend easily?
explanation: Supple is correct - S-U-P-P-L-E. Supple means bending and moving easily and gracefully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to consider carefully?
explanation: Contemplate is correct - C-O-N-T-E-M-P-L-A-T-E. To contemplate means to think about something carefully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very noticeable?
explanation: Conspicuous is correct - C-O-N-S-P-I-C-U-O-U-S. Conspicuous means standing out so as to be clearly visible.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to combine into a whole?
explanation: Integrate is correct - I-N-T-E-G-R-A-T-E. To integrate means to combine parts into a whole.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning making things more equal?
explanation: Equitable is correct - E-Q-U-I-T-A-B-L-E. Equitable means fair and impartial.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to become larger?
explanation: Proliferate is correct - P-R-O-L-I-F-E-R-A-T-E. To proliferate means to grow or reproduce rapidly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very complicated but clever?
explanation: Sophisticated is correct - S-O-P-H-I-S-T-I-C-A-T-E-D. Sophisticated means highly developed and complex.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to explain the cause of?
explanation: Attribute is correct - A-T-T-R-I-B-U-T-E. To attribute means to regard something as caused by someone.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very careful and thorough?
explanation: Meticulous is correct - M-E-T-I-C-U-L-O-U-S. Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to make use of?
explanation: Utilize is correct - U-T-I-L-I-Z-E. To utilize means to make practical and effective use of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning causing very strong feeling?
explanation: Evocative is correct - E-V-O-C-A-T-I-V-E. Evocative means bringing strong images or memories to mind.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to explain or represent?
explanation: Portray is correct - P-O-R-T-R-A-Y. To portray means to depict or describe in a picture or words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very important or key?
explanation: Pivotal is correct - P-I-V-O-T-A-L. Pivotal means of crucial importance in relation to the development of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to come together?
explanation: Converge is correct - C-O-N-V-E-R-G-E. To converge means to come from different directions to meet.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very bold and dramatic?
explanation: Flamboyant is correct - F-L-A-M-B-O-Y-A-N-T. Flamboyant means tending to attract attention because of exuberance or confidence.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to prove wrong?
explanation: Refute is correct - R-E-F-U-T-E. To refute means to prove a statement or theory to be wrong.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very impressive?
explanation: Magnificent is correct - M-A-G-N-I-F-I-C-E-N-T. Magnificent means impressively beautiful, elaborate, or extravagant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to look at something carefully?
explanation: Scrutinize is correct - S-C-R-U-T-I-N-I-Z-E. To scrutinize means to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very original?
explanation: Innovative is correct - I-N-N-O-V-A-T-I-V-E. Innovative means featuring new methods or ideas.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to start something?
explanation: Initiate is correct - I-N-I-T-I-A-T-E. To initiate means to cause a process to begin.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning full of energy?
explanation: Dynamic is correct - D-Y-N-A-M-I-C. Dynamic means characterized by constant change and progress.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to think about the future?
explanation: Anticipate is correct - A-N-T-I-C-I-P-A-T-E. To anticipate means to expect or predict something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not moving or changing?
explanation: Stagnant is correct - S-T-A-G-N-A-N-T. Stagnant means showing no activity or development.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to create something new?
explanation: Innovate is correct - I-N-N-O-V-A-T-E. To innovate means to make changes in something by introducing new methods or ideas.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning expressing a lot with few words?
explanation: Concise is correct - C-O-N-C-I-S-E. Concise means giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning causing great harm?
explanation: Devastating is correct - D-E-V-A-S-T-A-T-I-N-G. Devastating means highly destructive or damaging.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a verb meaning to find an answer to?
explanation: Resolve is correct - R-E-S-O-L-V-E. To resolve means to settle or find a solution to a problem.
